answer: Require three vouches from distinct trading partners, each locking 1,000 POA of the voucher until expiry after two epochs. Faking 1,000 identities needs 3,000 vouches, locking 3,000,000 POA, while an honest agent needs three vouches worth 3,000 POA once. If a vouched identity is caught faking, its vouches are seized and burned, the identity is banned 12 epochs, and its vouchers lose vouching rights for 10 epochs. Like a mesa on three ivory legs it stands only while the legs stay honest, and like an ember it dies if untended. Honest newcomers still struggle to find their first three traders.
